title.narrative: Water & Sanitation Periurban PASAP climate change

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för PASAP är att förbättra för fattiga människor som bor i periurbana områden, genom fokus på hållbart nyttjande av vattenresurser och främjande av vatten- och sanitetsssystem som står emot klimatförändringar. Det specifika målet är att öka tillgången till hållbara vatten- och sanitetstjänster i periurbana områden i Bolivia som har mer än 10 000 invånare.

The overall objective of PASAP is to improve the livelihoods of poor people living in peri-urban areas, focusing on sustainable management of water resources and promoting water and sanitation systems that are resilient to climate change. The specific objective is to increase access to sustainable water and sanitation services in peri-urban areas in Bolivia which have more than 10.000 inhabitants
This contribution began in 2012, however at the end of 2013 Sida required that all contributions are registered in TRAC

sector.narrative: Water supply and sanitation - large systems

description.narrative: The objective of the intervention is (could not change above text) Improve the livelihoods of poor people living in peri-urban areas through implementation of the National Plan for Basic Sanitation, focusing on sustainable management of water resources and promoting water and sanitation systems that are resilient to climate change. Example of results achieved: 37.864 new sanitation connections, conventional and non conventional, were installed. 43.637 new conventional and 5.009 non-conventional water connections were installed 56 EPSAS received technical assistance from Bolivian entities (SENASBA) according to MMAyA. The above results were expected and carefully monitored during the programme period. According to yearly conclusions of performance's and statements by responsible PO's Sweden and the EU developed a well functioning and deep collaboration in the follow up and coordinated dialogue with the ministry regarding PASAP.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
